title: Registry usage
description: Who uses the MCP Registry and how much, by day, week or month.

options.content: **How to read this.** The top two sections cover the whole selected time range. The charts below are grouped by ${period} (use the links above, or **Group by**) and show averages per day, so a week or month that is only partly covered stays comparable. Totals come from the gateway's request counters; shares come from a sample of access records scaled to those totals. Cost is data sent at $${cost_per_gib} per GiB. Names are kept down to each day's top 50 organizations, 40 clients and 30 networks; the smallest rest on a few sampled records, so read them as rough.

panels.title: How much: the selected time range in total

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, requests AS "Requests" FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1
SELECT day AS time, gib AS "Data sent" FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Estimated cost
panels.description: Data sent in the selected range at $${cost_per_gib} per GiB (egress plus load balancer data processing).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, gib * $cost_per_gib AS "Estimated cost" FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per month at this rate
panels.description: Estimated cost per month: the average estimated cost per day in the selected range, times 30.44 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(gib) * $cost_per_gib * 30.44 AS "Per month" FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Largest client
panels.description: The named organization or product that received the most data in the selected range, and its share of all data sent.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Client", data_pct AS "Share of data" FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 1) WHERE kind = 'named'

panels.title: Days with data
panels.description: Full UTC days in the selected range that have a report. Totals on this row add up these days only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Days" FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Who: the selected time range in total
Where the data goes
panels.description: Share of all data sent in the selected range. Named organizations are ranked by data received.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'unnamed' THEN replace(name, 'Unnamed clients on', 'Unnamed, on') WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'Smaller named clients' WHEN pos = 1 THEN name WHEN pos <= 10 THEN 'Named, ranked 2 to 10' ELSE 'Named, ranked 11 to 50' END AS "Group", sum(data_pct) AS "Share" FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(pos)

panels.title: Where the requests come from
panels.description: Share of all requests in the selected range, in the same groups as the panel on the left.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'unnamed' THEN replace(name, 'Unnamed clients on', 'Unnamed, on') WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'Smaller named clients' WHEN pos = 1 THEN name WHEN pos <= 10 THEN 'Named, ranked 2 to 10' ELSE 'Named, ranked 11 to 50' END AS "Group", sum(requests_pct) AS "Share" FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(pos)

panels.title: After the largest client: data per day
panels.description: The next twelve named organizations by data received in the selected range, as an average per day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Name", gib / days AS "Data per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 13) WHERE kind = 'named' AND pos > 1 ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Organizations and products: the top 50 named, then the rest
panels.description: Ranked by data received over the selected range. Days seen counts the days a name was in that day's top 50; addresses are an average per day, because distinct addresses cannot be added up across days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'named' THEN pos END AS "#", CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' smaller named clients a day' ELSE name END AS "Organization or product", identified_by AS "Identified by", requests_pct AS "Requests", data_pct AS "Data sent", gib / days AS "Data per day", gib * $cost_per_gib AS "Cost in range", gib / days * $cost_per_gib * 30.44 AS "Per month at this rate", compressed_pct AS "Listings compressed", addresses_per_day AS "Addresses per day", days_seen || ' of ' || days AS "Days seen" FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Totals for each ${period}
panels.description: One row per ${period} in the selected range, newest first. Days with data shows how much of the ${period} is covered, so compare the per-day columns when a ${period} is partial. The last column is the largest client's share of data sent.

targets.rawSql: WITH top_share AS (SELECT time, max(100 * gib / bucket_gib) AS share FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE kind = 'named' GROUP BY time) SELECT CASE '${period}' WHEN 'day' THEN to_char(b.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Dy Mon DD') WHEN 'week' THEN 'Week of ' || to_char(b.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Mon DD') ELSE to_char(b.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Mon YYYY') END AS "Period", b.days || ' of ' || b.days_in_period AS "Days with data", b.requests AS "Requests", b.gib AS "Data sent", b.gib * $cost_per_gib AS "Estimated cost", b.requests / b.days AS "Requests per day", b.gib / b.days AS "Data per day", b.gib / b.days * $cost_per_gib * 30.44 AS "Per month at this rate", t.share AS "Largest client's share" FROM usage_buckets('${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) b LEFT JOIN top_share t USING (time) ORDER BY b.bucket DESC

panels.title: Requests per day, by ${period}
panels.description: Average requests per day within each ${period}.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, requests / days AS "Requests per day" FROM usage_buckets('${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Data sent per day, by organization and ${period}
panels.description: Average data per day within each ${period}: the eight organizations that received the most data in the selected range, all smaller named ones together, and the two groups of clients that could not be named.

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 8) WHERE kind = 'named') SELECT s.time, CASE WHEN s.kind = 'unnamed' THEN replace(s.name, 'Unnamed clients on', 'Unnamed, on') WHEN s.kind = 'named' AND s.name IN (SELECT name FROM top) THEN s.name ELSE 'All smaller named' END AS metric, round(sum(s.gib) / max(s.days), 1) AS value FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Largest client: share of requests and data
panels.description: The largest client of the selected range, and its share of each ${period}.

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 1) WHERE kind = 'named'), s AS (SELECT s.* FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) s JOIN top USING (name) WHERE s.kind = 'named') SELECT time, name || ': share of data' AS metric, 100 * gib / bucket_gib AS value FROM s UNION ALL SELECT time, name || ': share of requests', 100 * requests / bucket_requests FROM s ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: After the largest client: data per day, by ${period}
panels.description: The next ten named organizations by data received in the selected range, as an average per day within each ${period}. A point is missing when a name was outside the top 50 on every day of that ${period}.

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM usage_leaderboard('organization', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 11) WHERE kind = 'named' AND pos > 1) SELECT s.time, s.name AS metric, round(s.gib / s.days, 1) AS value FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) s JOIN top USING (name) WHERE s.kind = 'named' ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Biggest movers: the latest ${period} against the one before
panels.description: Named organizations with the largest change in data per day between the two most recent ${period}s in the selected range. A blank means the name was outside the top 50 throughout that ${period}. Names under 1 GiB a day in both are left out.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, name, gib / days AS per_day FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE kind = 'named'), t AS (SELECT time, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY time DESC) AS age FROM (SELECT DISTINCT time FROM s) x), cur AS (SELECT s.name, s.per_day FROM s JOIN t USING (time) WHERE t.age = 1), prev AS (SELECT s.name, s.per_day FROM s JOIN t USING (time) WHERE t.age = 2) SELECT name AS "Organization or product", prev.per_day AS "Before", cur.per_day AS "Latest", cur.per_day - prev.per_day AS "Change", 100 * (cur.per_day / nullif(prev.per_day, 0) - 1) AS "Change %" FROM cur FULL JOIN prev USING (name) WHERE greatest(coalesce(cur.per_day, 0), coalesce(prev.per_day, 0)) >= 1 ORDER BY abs(coalesce(cur.per_day, 0) - coalesce(prev.per_day, 0)) DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Names seen per day, by ${period}
panels.description: Average per day within each ${period}. These are daily counts, not the number of distinct names across the whole ${period}. A day stored without the network-owner table is left out of the network count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.time, round(b.named_orgs) AS "Named organizations and products", round(b.user_agents) AS "Distinct user agents", (SELECT round(avg(coalesce(x.n, 0))) FROM usage_daily d LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.kind = 'named') + coalesce(max(s.rollup_count), 0) AS n FROM usage_share s WHERE s.dimension = 'network' AND $__timeFilter(s.day) GROUP BY s.day) x USING (day) WHERE date_trunc('${period}', d.day, 'UTC') = b.bucket AND $__timeFilter(d.day) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.caveats) AS caveat WHERE caveat LIKE 'The network-owner table could not be loaded%')) AS "Networks" FROM usage_buckets('${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) b ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Share of data, by size of client and ${period}
panels.description: Named organizations ranked by data received within each ${period}, then everything that could not be named.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE pos = 1) / max(bucket_gib) AS "Largest client", 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE pos BETWEEN 2 AND 10) / max(bucket_gib) AS "Ranked 2 to 10", 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE pos BETWEEN 11 AND 50) / max(bucket_gib) AS "Ranked 11 to 50", 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'other' OR pos > 50) / max(bucket_gib) AS "Smaller named clients", 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'unnamed' AND name LIKE '%cloud%') / max(bucket_gib) AS "Unnamed, on cloud hosting", 100 * sum(gib) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'unnamed' AND name NOT LIKE '%cloud%') / max(bucket_gib) AS "Unnamed, on internet providers" FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Share of requests, by size of client and ${period}
panels.description: The same groups as the panel on the left, by share of requests.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE pos = 1) / max(bucket_requests) AS "Largest client", 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE pos BETWEEN 2 AND 10) / max(bucket_requests) AS "Ranked 2 to 10", 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE pos BETWEEN 11 AND 50) / max(bucket_requests) AS "Ranked 11 to 50", 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'other' OR pos > 50) / max(bucket_requests) AS "Smaller named clients", 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'unnamed' AND name LIKE '%cloud%') / max(bucket_requests) AS "Unnamed, on cloud hosting", 100 * sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'unnamed' AND name NOT LIKE '%cloud%') / max(bucket_requests) AS "Unnamed, on internet providers" FROM usage_series('organization', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unnamed clients, by network
panels.description: Over the selected range: requests from generic clients (HTTP libraries, runtimes, browsers, no user agent) on networks that do not identify an organization, split by the network they came from. Compressed is the share of their listing responses sent compressed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT upper(left(category, 1)) || substr(category, 2) AS "Hosted on", CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' others a day' ELSE name END AS "Network", requests_pct AS "Requests", data_pct AS "Data sent", gib / days AS "Data per day", compressed_pct AS "Compressed", addresses_per_day AS "Addresses per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('unnamed_network', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 12, true) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Unnamed clients, by client software
panels.description: The same unnamed requests over the selected range, split by what the user agent says the client is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' others a day' ELSE name END AS "Client", requests_pct AS "Requests", data_pct AS "Data sent", gib / days AS "Data per day", compressed_pct AS "Compressed", addresses_per_day AS "Addresses per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('unnamed_client', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 12) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: How it is used, and how efficiently, by ${period}

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, name AS metric, 100 * requests / bucket_requests AS value FROM usage_series('endpoint', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Listing requests, by what the client was doing

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, name AS metric, 100 * requests / bucket_requests AS value FROM usage_series('listing_use', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Listing compression, all clients
panels.description: Share of successful listing responses sent compressed, and the share of listing data they carried.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, listings_compressed_pct AS "Listing responses compressed", listings_compressed_data_pct AS "Listing data carried by compressed responses" FROM usage_buckets('${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Listing requests served from the gateway cache

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, cache_hit_pct AS "Served from cache" FROM usage_buckets('${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Responses that were not a success
panels.description: Share of all requests, by outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, name AS metric, 100 * requests / bucket_requests AS value FROM usage_series('response', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE name <> 'success' ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: What gets looked up: servers and namespaces
Server lookups per day
panels.description: Requests that read one specific server (its version list, or one version), as an average per day over the selected range. Listing requests are not lookups: they return pages of the whole catalogue.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(requests) / max(days) AS "Lookups per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('server_type', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50)

panels.title: Share of all requests
panels.description: Server lookups as a share of all requests in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(requests_pct) AS "Share" FROM usage_leaderboard('server_type', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50)

panels.title: Servers looked up per day, at least
panels.description: Distinct catalogued servers seen in each day's sample of lookups, averaged over the days in the selected range. A day on which no catalogued server was looked up counts as zero; a day stored without a catalogue is left out. The sample holds about one lookup in 75, so the true number is higher.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(coalesce(x.n, 0)) AS "Servers" FROM usage_daily d LEFT JOIN (SELECT day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'named') + coalesce(max(rollup_count), 0) AS n FROM usage_share WHERE dimension = 'server' AND $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day) x USING (day) WHERE $__timeFilter(d.day) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(d.caveats) AS caveat WHERE caveat LIKE 'No published servers were available%')

panels.title: For names not in the catalogue
panels.description: Share of lookups that asked for a name the public catalogue does not have. Those names are not kept, only counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * coalesce(sum(requests) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'unnamed'), 0) / sum(requests) AS "Share" FROM usage_leaderboard('server_type', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50)

panels.title: Most looked-up servers
panels.description: Over the selected range, ranked by lookups. Only names in the public catalogue are listed. Asked most by is the organization or product that asked for a server most, and From it is its share of that server's lookups; From others a day is what is left, which is the better guide to broad demand when one client polls a fixed list. These three are blank when the days in the range, or the servers grouped into one row, do not agree on who asked most. Not found is the share of lookups that returned 404, usually a version that does not exist. Click a column heading to sort by it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'named' THEN pos END AS "#", CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' other servers a day' ELSE name END AS "Server", category AS "Type", requests / days AS "Lookups a day", 100 * requests / sum(requests) OVER () AS "Share", identified_by AS "Asked most by", top_client_pct AS "From it", requests / days * (1 - top_client_pct / 100) AS "From others a day", not_found_pct AS "Not found" FROM usage_leaderboard('server', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50, false, true) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Most looked-up namespaces
panels.description: The same lookups grouped by namespace, the part of a server name before the slash.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'named' THEN pos END AS "#", CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' others a day' ELSE name END AS "Namespace", category AS "Proved by", requests / days AS "Lookups per day", 100 * requests / sum(requests) OVER () AS "Share" FROM usage_leaderboard('server_namespace', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 40, false, true) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Lookups per day for the top servers, by ${period}
panels.description: The eight most looked-up servers of the selected range, as an average per day within each ${period}.

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM usage_leaderboard('server', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 8, false, true) WHERE kind = 'named') SELECT s.time, s.name AS metric, round(s.requests / s.days) AS value FROM usage_series('server', '${period}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) s JOIN top USING (name) WHERE s.kind = 'named' ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Lookups by type of server
panels.description: Lookups over the selected range, by the type of the server that was asked for.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Type", requests / days AS "Lookups per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('server_type', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 50, false, true) ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: More detail: the selected time range in total
Client software, as named in the user agent: the top 40

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' others a day' ELSE name END AS "Client", requests_pct AS "Requests", data_pct AS "Data sent", gib / days AS "Data per day", compressed_pct AS "Compressed", addresses_per_day AS "Addresses per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('client', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 40) ORDER BY pos

panels.title: Network owner of the source address: the top 30

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'other' THEN 'About ' || round(names_per_day) || ' others a day' ELSE name END AS "Network", upper(left(category, 1)) || substr(category, 2) AS "Type", requests_pct AS "Requests", data_pct AS "Data sent", gib / days AS "Data per day", addresses_per_day AS "Addresses per day" FROM usage_leaderboard('network', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), 30) ORDER BY pos
